newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declares disaster in two Idaho counties.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declares disaster in two Idaho counties.

text.p: President Clinton Tuesday extended federal disaster relief to individuals and businesses in two Idaho counties hit hard by severe storms and mudslides.
Clinton's action provides disaster housing, grants and low-cost loans to victims in Bingham and Jefferson counties.
Clinton earlier approved federal assistance to the state and local governments to help restore damaged public facilities.
